errors.alreadyRegistered: Another app already uses “{{hotkey}}”. Pick a different shortcut, or turn it off in that app.

validation.mouseButtonCombination: Mouse buttons can’t be combined with other keys. Use the button on its own.
validation.tooManyKeys: A shortcut can have up to three keys. Drop one and try again.
validation.leftRightMix: A shortcut can’t mix the left and right versions of one modifier. Use one side.
validation.noModifierOrSpecial: A shortcut needs a modifier like ⌘ or ⌃, or a special key such as an arrow, Space or a function key.
validation.modifierOnlyUnsupported: macOS doesn’t support shortcuts made of two modifiers alone. Use one right-side modifier like Right ⌥, or add a regular key.
validation.leftModifierOnly: A modifier on its own must be the right-side key, like Right ⌥. Or add a regular key, as in ⌃Space.
validation.reserved: macOS reserves that shortcut. Pick a different one.
validation.reservedNamed: macOS reserves {{label}}. Pick a different shortcut.
